crm_data_quality.name: CRM data quality issues — duplicates, missing fields, stale contacts

manual_reporting.name: Manual reporting and data aggregation from multiple sources
effective_solutions: Claude workflow connecting data sources to unified report

onboarding_friction.name: Onboarding friction for employees and customers
effective_solutions: AI-generated onboarding guides from existing docs

tool_sprawl.name: Tool sprawl without integration — 5-10+ SaaS tools that don't talk to each other
typical_causes: Each department chose their own tool

effective_patterns: Connect existing tools before replacing — most businesses get 80% of value from integration
Start with highest-ROI automation first — quick wins build momentum
Build on tools the team already knows — adoption is the hardest part
Automate data sync between core systems — eliminates most manual work
AI workflows for repetitive tasks first, then expand to complex ones
anti_patterns: Recommending enterprise tools to SMBs — overkill and budget-breaking
Suggesting migration when integration would work — disruption without benefit
Automating processes that are broken — fix the process first
Building custom when SaaS exists and fits — don't reinvent the wheel
Ignoring team capability — recommending builds to non-technical teams
